note: The operation a Soveraeign swarm would perform: a participant takes one bounded concern, works it, and lands the result. This is the first reading taken with a grader rather than typed, and it is a self-assessment by a participant that also builds on this surface, so it establishes BUILT evidence and witnesses nothing.

reachability.note: Declared endpoints are machine-readable and the console can be asked what operations exist, but the landing step itself is a script a participant has to be told about: it is not a declared service operation, and the gateway operation that would list endpoints is PROPOSED.

evidence.observed: the grader itself is reachable only as a script, not a declared operation
list-endpoints and the other eight gateway operations are all PROPOSED

commitment.note: Proposal, build and acceptance are distinguishable and the landing gate cannot ratify. Attestation is declared and unexercised, so the full ladder is not yet observable end to end.

evidence.observed: the standing grant is typed VERIFICATION and cannot ratify a JUDGEMENT claim
attest-observation is PROPOSED, so attestation leaves no record today

provenance.note: A landed change resolves to a commit, a tree and an observation file. What the model read before producing it resolves to nothing: there is no context package and no model invocation receipt.

evidence.observed: every landed change resolves to a commit and the paths it touched
package-context is PROPOSED, so no digest-pinned context record exists
invoke_model is declared with no kernel implementation (PROD-I-9)

retraction.note: Record-local counteraction is built and preserves history. Effect-class aware counteraction is not: nothing in the landing path exercises a counter-record, and consumed model resources are neither measured nor declared unrefundable.

evidence.observed: counter-entry is BUILT and the journal is append-preserving
the landing path ends at commit and merge; no counter-record is produced

same_world_parity.note: A human binding interface is declared; nothing drives both sides of one operation.

typed_authority.note: The grant is typed, scoped, budgeted and checked at the operation, and refuses. Attribution is the untested half: the actor is a string the request supplies and no principal is resolved at the gate.

independent_observation.note: The grant requires an independent observation and the evaluator decides independence from a boolean the request writes about itself. An executor that can assert its own witness is the success oracle.

evidence.observed: _observation_verdict refuses only when observation.contributed_to_build is true, a field supplied by the same request
requires_independent_observation is true and rests on that field

receipt_completeness.note: Admission and refusal leave records; observation and counteraction do not yet.

effect_honesty.note: Nothing meters what a run consumes, so there is no claim about refunds to be honest or dishonest about yet.

cold_start_competence.note: A fresh instance is oriented by CLAUDE.md and a checked snapshot, and neither time to useful nor intervention count is measured.

two_binding_proof.note: FOUND-006 is a seed narrative; no fixture drives a human and a model binding.

local_sovereignty.note: The record and the payload store are local, and whether this operation survives the loss of the provider that performs it has never been tried.

model_substitutability.note: Two local models have declared bindings and an adapter that measures what a run consumes. The model that actually performs this operation has neither, so its identity, crossed data, usage and cost are not visible anywhere.

evidence.observed: a declared binding for a model that performs none of this work
principal:claude-opus-5 is anchored to a declared binding that has no adapter
